learning_outcomes.text: Use an object oriented programming language to design, implement, test and debug small applications.
Understand and apply the concepts of encapsulation, abstraction, inheritance and polymorphism.
Know how to use the fundamental data structures of a standard library (stacks, queues, trees, hashtables).
Explain the utility of design patterns and demonstrate their usage in simple cases.

assessment_rules: For Mode A, assessment includes 10% class participation, 40% Written test (Test 1) with a minimum of 8, and 50% Project with a minimum of 8. For Mode B, assessment includes 50% Written test (Test 1) with a minimum of 8, and 50% Project with a minimum of 8. Test 1 can be replaced if the mark is less than 8 by a Written test on the 1st term date. The project grade is limited by individual oral discussion performance: no limit for very good, 16 marks for good, 12 marks for sufficient, and failure for poor performance. The special assessment period consists of a project and a test, each 50%. Grades can only be improved the following year.
